* Translate architectural designs, business requirements, and workflow needs into reliable production\-ready solutions.
* Design, prototype, and validate technical solutions and proofs of concept.
* Develop and maintain integrations using REST APIs, Microsoft Graph API, healthcare system APIs, and third\-party platforms.
* Collaborate with Data \& Analytics teams and business stakeholders to align technical solutions with organizational objectives.
* Maintain and enhance existing production systems, applications, automations, integrations, and microservices.
* Implement monitoring, alerting, error handling, troubleshooting, and resiliency measures to ensure system reliability and security.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, runbooks, and support documentation.
* Develop reporting and dashboard solutions using Power BI or similar visualization tools and leverage AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, testing, documentation, and analysis.
* Other related duties as assigned.
